title: campanula patula subsp. flaccida
intro: Campanula patula subsp. flaccida, commonly known as Bellflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Campanula patula subsp. flaccida include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities, making it a potential candidate for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
